scope: production provider/broker/cache and SQLite repositories with synthetic parsed-file/network input; no real scan, live matching, desktop or hardware proof
cases: closed review scope and source binding reject duplicate/oversized item lists and supplied unknown fields
40 owned rows retain 800 candidates beyond ordinary 400-token eviction and all first/last choices still resolve
returned preview mutation cannot alter private source text
review rejects out-of-scope item and already-closed token before candidate retention
re-query replaces only one row; prior row token is gone and other row choices remain owned
canceling one request releases only its retained row candidates
derived edition/full-credit candidates share the same owned lifetime and do not consume ordinary preview lifetime
recording reference edit is detected even when the legacy metadata fingerprint is unchanged; derived candidates fail too
durable reviewed plan records source bindings, survives preview close and replays creation receipt
offline execution rejects a changed recording source without overwriting values or relying on a live preview token
unchanged peer row still executes independently offline
successful peer can be independently compensated while the conflict remains untouched
closed retry origin and edition readers reject foreign fields, wrong revisions, excessive text and nontext values
re-review reads current item snapshot and historical unresolved row offline without including compensated peer or changing original plan
stale original revision and foreign or already-compensated row reject before creating new batch or receipt
late retry-row insert fault rolls back the new batch and receipt while original plan remains byte-equivalent
new re-reviewed plan stores authoritative original relationship, current snapshot and private edition independently of closed preview
new retry executes and compensates independently offline without rewriting old conflict or compensated peer
expired, failed and cancelled remaining rows are all available for explicit re-review with retained prior reasons
ISRC lookup evidence persists and later local code change blocks offline plan execution
read-only release context request preserves old query shape and rejects edit values, invalid modes or cursors
selected edition plan exposes release-bound album source independently of recording URL and survives preview close
16MiB retention budget failure preserves earlier accepted preview instead of partially replacing it
four concurrent review sessions are bounded and excess session creation rejects without evicting existing reviews
expired review sessions are removed and cannot be revived
current-schema backup/reopen retain lookup evidence, receipt and individual conflict/compensation outcomes
